posts.author: megamix90
posts.body: Does anyone know if there's a plugin for MV that makes text uninterrupted, similar to Undertale and Deltarune? I want it so that if you have text in a battle, it doesn't stop the battle and then disappear. I want it to stay on screen throughout choosing actions. If there is a way to do this in RPG Maker MV, or if there is a plugin, please let me know. Thanks.
